candidate: provider-only identity copy; generic JSON unchanged

method.order: baseline/candidate repeated three times sequentially in fresh VMs; no owned gates or negative controls during final comparisons
method.retention: Separate disposable worker per fixture; construct checked values, tail-call into hold, full worker GC, inspect unique off-heap binary allocations, release all values, full worker GC again. No installed daemon touched.
method.timing: Untraced, five warmups then fifty calls; input construction and retention GC probes excluded. Primitive comparison uses 1000 warmups and 100000 calls.
method.ownership_scope: One process per fixture; binary IDs deduplicated within that process. Never sum shared allocations across processes.
method.limits: Synthetic fixtures on a shared Mac; other host activity uncontrolled. Process allocated bytes include spare heap capacity and are not exact reachable size. Binary bytes exclude process heaps and are not RSS. No live resource reduction, whole-tool speedup or workload prevalence claim.

discarded_global_copy_experiment.scope: Synthetic core JSON singleton-field copying; NOT part of final production change. Separate three alternating comparisons.
